---
name: Something looks wrong
about: A part of the page is unreadable, unstyled, or the wrong colour
labels: bug
---

**Screenshot** — the most useful thing you can include. Circle the part that is
wrong if it isn't obvious.

**Where** — the page URL, or which screen (project page, dashboard, editor).

**Theme** — which one, and whether Wallpaper was on or off.

**Browser and version** — and whether you loaded it unpacked or from a package.

**Anything in the console?** Right-click → Inspect → Console. Extension errors
show up there.
